title: Logic and argument
learning_outcomes: Explain premises and conclusions in the context of logic and argument.
Compare and distinguish validity and soundness in the context of logic and argument.
Apply induction and fallacies in the context of logic and argument.
Evaluate and justify decisions about steelmanning in the context of logic and argument.

lessons.title: Premises and conclusions
lessons.outcome: Explain premises and conclusions in the context of logic and argument.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving premises and conclusions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to two-sided argument map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain premises and conclusions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of premises and conclusions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Validity and soundness
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish validity and soundness in the context of logic and argument.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving validity and soundness; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to two-sided argument map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain validity and soundness from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of validity and soundness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Induction and fallacies
lessons.outcome: Apply induction and fallacies in the context of logic and argument.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving induction and fallacies; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to two-sided argument map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain induction and fallacies from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of induction and fallacies; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Steelmanning
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about steelmanning in the context of logic and argument.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving steelmanning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to two-sided argument map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain steelmanning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of steelmanning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of premises and conclusions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of validity and soundness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of induction and fallacies; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of steelmanning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
